// diagnostic

E1114

`freeze` cannot snapshot `{ty}`: {reason}

What

`freeze` cannot snapshot `{ty}`: {reason}

Why

A frozen value must be an owned cloneable value with no shared handle, resource, function, trait value, or mutable view inside it.

Fix

use `^` to give the owned value to the task, use `Shared`/`Cell` for deliberate shared state, or rebuild a plain owned value

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1114: tests/ui/freeze_shared_source.stderr.

Error [E1114]: `freeze` cannot snapshot `Shared<Int>`: the value contains `Shared`, whose lock-backed handle would keep shared mutation
  --> tests/ui/freeze_shared_source.jet:3:12
    |
  3 |     freeze(handle)
    |            ^^^^^^
 Why: A frozen value must be an owned cloneable value with no shared handle, resource, function, trait value, or mutable view inside it.
 Fix: use `^` to give the owned value to the task, use `Shared`/`Cell` for deliberate shared state, or rebuild a plain owned value
